title: Anna Paulina Luna's MK Ultra hearing

tellings.quote: Like he's friends with um uh Anna Pina Luna. Okay. She seems to be an insider. She just yesterday had a big u congressional hearing on MK Ultra.

plain: In 2026 the member of Congress Anna Paulina Luna held what the skeptic Michael Shermer calls "a big congressional hearing" on MK Ultra, a Cold War CIA programme of mind-control experiments. Shermer mentions it to Michels while talking about the researcher Avi Loeb, saying Loeb is friends with Luna, that she "seems to be an insider", and that the hearing had happened "just yesterday". He brings it up as a sign that people close to the UFO debate have friends in Congress.
